From: ops@solarflare.com

Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor invites timing out on Coupa - need help

Hi Tessa and Ben,

We're trying to onboard three vendor contacts into our Coupa supplier portal for upcoming PO workflows. Two of the invites either arrive very late (20+ minutes) or the OTP they receive expires before they can complete activation. We tested with internal accounts and saw the same delay.

Steps we took:
- Triggered invite from your portal at 13:35 PDT (screen attached).
- Vendor got the email at ~13:56, clicked the link, received OTP that returned 410 when validated.
- Tried resending at 13:58 and 14:02; second invite failed with same OTP expiry.

Impact: blocked PO creation for this supplier. We're on a tight timeline for Q3 shipments.

Attachments: screenshot_otp_delay.png (screenshot of email timestamps)

Can you confirm whether invite TTLs or mailer queues might be causing this? Any immediate workaround would be great — e.g., extend OTP validity or resend with a different template.

Thanks,
Rina Kapoor
Lead, Procurement Ops
Solarflare Systems
ops@solarflare.com

Hi Rina — thanks for the quick report and the screenshot, that helps. We're looking into the mailer and invite service now.

Quick asks while we triage:
- Do you have the vendor emails (I assume external): please paste them so we can trace the message IDs.
- Can you confirm the timezone of the vendor recipients? (we've seen timezone-aware scheduling misfires before)

Plan:
1) Ben will pull invite logs and mailer queue traces for the specific message-ids you provide.
2) We'll temporarily extend the OTP TTL for the supplier-invite flow to 30 minutes for your org and resend.
3) If resend works, we'll follow with a root-cause investigation and a permanent fix (likely TTL mismatch or outbound mail batching).

I'm looping in Jordan (product) to capture any template-level quirks for Coupa redirects.

I'll follow up within the hour with logs or a test invite.

—Tessa

Subject: Fwd: New vendor invites timing out on Coupa - need help

Forwarded message:
> From: ops@solarflare.com
> Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 14:05:00 -0700
> Subject: New vendor invites timing out on Coupa - need help

Triage notes (summary of findings):
- Pulled mailer trace for the tenant (Solarflare org id 67890). The invite emails were generated at 20:35:12 UTC and placed on the outbound queue. There is a 1,080 second gap between generation and actual SMTP handoff for two of the messages — that matches your ~20 minute observation.
- Cause appears to be a transient backlog on the low-priority outbound worker pool responsible for non-critical transactional templates. During a config push last night we changed rate limits for that pool and a bucket refill delay created a short spike.
- OTP expiration default is 10 minutes; with the 18–20 minute queue delay that yields an expired code by the time the vendor clicks.

Immediate remediation I performed at 15:00 PDT:
- Increased OTP TTL to 30 minutes for Solarflare tenant (runtime flag).
- Requeued the three pending invites (same message-ids) with high-priority tag.
- Sent one test invite to rina+test@solarflare.com — it arrived in 18 seconds and activation completed successfully.

Next steps / follow-up items:
- We'll revert the runtime TTL change after the window unless you want it permanent — recommend a bounded rollback once we fix the outbound worker refill policy.
- Raise a config rollback PR to adjust the bucket refill to avoid future spikes (SUP-1248).

Attachments: invite-log-snippet.txt (mailer trace for the three messages)

Ben
Principal Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
